meta.eml1_departure: cheaper of a burn at Earth-Moon L1 and a perigee drop to 300 km with a perigee burn
meta.method: Cheapest single-revolution Lambert transfer (pykep, DE440 sites) per 30-day departure date; parking-orbit Oberth costs at planets as in the network; rendezvous at the station.

objectives.reach: mean cheapest cost from the station to the 11 sites other than Earth, km/s
objectives.value: share of Earth-launched mass one station saves on trips from low Earth orbit to the other sites, when the station makes its own propellant
objectives.network: mean cost of the longer leg when every trip between two sites may refuel once at a station of the set, km/s; without stations the direct trip
objectives.control: share of site-to-site trips where a refuelling stop at the station gives two legs each cheaper than the direct trip
objectives.supply: cheapest mean cost to deliver propellant to the station from the available sources, km/s

qubo.form: minimise sum_o a_o x_o + sum_{o<o'} b_{oo'} x_o x_{o'} + lambda (sum_o x_o - k)^2; a = -gain, b = overlap of gains
